reading.zh: 先是能力门禁（路径归一、范围包含与受保护委托），再是它保护的文件系统与向量/日志适配器，最后是交给不可信代码的 ScopedDataDisk 对象。
reading.en: The capability gate comes first (path scoping, containment and guarded delegation), then the filesystem and vector/log adapters it protects, and finally the ScopedDataDisk object handed to untrusted code.
